title: Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2610.00314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet ($D-M=-.0026$, 95 percent interval [$-.0174$, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020

translated_title: 预测性信用：衡量科学解释为实验预测带来的增益
translated_abstract: 研究智能体会对计划进行的实验给出解释。我们通过配对预测来测量“预测性信用”：这些配对预测共享相同的干预、预测者和结果，而仅在描述、匹配解释和供体上下文上有所不同。五项检查分别跟踪承诺、交付、预测增益、一致性和已知信号吸收。在受控学习中的336个前瞻状态、12个Tox21终点和24个OpenML任务上，v5版本的冻结信用决策尚无定论。Tox21的预注册ROC AUC区间分数危害检验未通过（D-M=-0.0026，95%区间[-0.0174, 0.0104]）；OpenML的联合形成、点等价性与可重复性规则也未满足。匹配解释相对于纯描述的点精度增益仍未得到确认，且Tox21/OpenML的种子-供体区间均跨越零。在指定的DeepSeek V4 Pro下，匹配卡和供体卡将次要Tox21漂移分别降低了64.5%和59.1%；而DeepSeek V4 Flash的重放则使匹配点MAE从0.01823升至0.02020。
tldr: 论文提出“预测性信用”框架，通过配对预测和五项预注册检验来量化科学解释对实验预测的实际增益，结果在Tox21与OpenML基准上均无定论——解释未能带来可确认的点精度提升，但显著降低了预测漂移。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "Predictive Credit," a paired-forecast framework with five preregistered checks to quantify what matched explanations add to experimental forecasts, finding inconclusive credit decisions on Tox21 and OpenML—no confirmed point-accuracy gains, though explanation cards substantially reduced secondary drift.
